data.long_meaning: Derived from the Arabic word ‘Khalasa’ which means ‘to be empty or cleansed’. In Islamic context, it symbolizes purification of the soul through acts of devotion and good deeds. The name Khulaisah carries the meaning “Gentle, Delicate, Tender” and is chosen by families in Islamic traditions for the positive qualities it expresses. Linguistically it belongs to the Arabic tradition and is also used in Arabic, Urdu, Persian. Parents who choose Khulaisah usually hope their child will grow to embody gentle, delicate, tender and live with faith, good character and purpose.

In this sense, the name "Khulaisah" serves as a reminder of the importance of spiritual growth and self-improvement in Islam.
